assertion_analysis.fails_if: Fails if the pinned artifact digest, split label, zero unjudged count or route-count total changes independently; route counts and n can move together, so that sum alone does not prove calibration provenance.
Fails if the pinned digest check ceases to reject a planted cutoff or weight edit.
Fails if a noncanonical Jev row changes count, mean or disagreement in the query-shaped aggregate model.
Fails if route storage omits the row, gives it canonical status or a scalar score, or loses the route answer.
Fails if direct results drop the named failure or the existing check trigger rejects the supplied positive check; its expected check ID is also the injected one.
Fails if the production veto substitutes the generic claim for the independently planted named sentence.
Fails if the audit builder bypasses the patched owner when explicit conventions are present.
Fails if either axis changes the independently planted 0.8 accept comparison or its strict lower edge.
Fails if either axis misses the independently planted 0.6 failure comparison or drops the injected check ID.
Fails if either axis changes the planted 0.2 lower boundary; it guards the implemented low-tail label, which is a blocking plan mismatch.
Fails if shadow mode omits the route, narrows the two-seat incumbent call or changes the independent mocked incumbent score.

Fails if accept or refine invokes the incumbent, or if chat uses more than the first model; its line 383 method suffix is derived from the injected route and does not independently test classifier selection.
Fails if restored stage authority rejects direct accept or refine or records a quorum shortfall.
Fails if a refused lease or raised judgment omits unjudged storage or narrows the full incumbent seat list.

Fails if four planted failure combinations omit the noncanonical unjudged row, lose its reason, change the incumbent result or change aggregates; the static route-share assertion alone does not prove dynamic exclusion.
Fails if an empty documentation decision stops raising ValueError.
Fails if an unanswered name result stops raising ValueError.
Fails if the worker loses failed-check prompt context or stops choosing the existing check trigger.

findings.text: A check-clear score below reject_threshold becomes chat_below_reject and adjudicate_review sends it to a chat reviewer; plan §6 permits chat only inside the uncertain band, so the zero calibration count does not make this fourth runtime route safe.

A fixed USD 0.001 reservation precedes an unbounded Jev call and no provider-exposure check; BudgetLease.charge_event records any excess only after billing, so this new production call can overrun the reserved budget.

The expected resolution-method suffix is built from the same route string injected into the mocked judgment, so this assertion cannot detect a classifier that selects the wrong route; the independent threshold tests cover classification separately.
